Dear FrieslandCampina Recruitment Team,

I would like to apply for the Global Traineeship Commerce.

I am a digital marketer with a technical background: I work freelance in SEO, AI search and WordPress, and I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto (remote).

My work sits where commercial goals meet execution. I build and optimize websites, write content that ranks, and track results in Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. I have built and maintained e-commerce stores and content-heavy sites, including Shopify stores where I manage the product catalogue and content, and a pharmacists' association site with around 600 member profiles.

I am fluent in English, curious about both B2C and B2B, and used to working with colleagues and clients across countries. I would welcome the chance to discuss what I could contribute to a rotation such as Shopper Marketing or Distributor Excellence.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Global Traineeship Commerce. What draws me to it is the mix the vacancy describes: brands, shoppers, distributors and the analysis behind every commercial decision. That combination is close to the work I already do, just from the digital side.

At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Google Search Console. For consultancy and e-commerce clients like etkendanismanlik.com and proteinbox.com.tr, I write keyword-targeted blog content and optimize pages to grow organic traffic. On my own account, I run baverok.com and built mirook.com for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data, knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file and running iterative technical audits. I also build Shopify stores such as harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com: store design, product catalogue, blog content.

Earlier, at Knowledge Experts (kxp.biz), I supported the team on SharePoint-based digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market (4,000+ stores, ERP/POS integration) and Aras Kargo (an application gallery for 12,000 staff). That work taught me how much sits behind a single commercial decision in a large organisation.

My degree background is in computer science rather than business, so my commercial understanding comes from client work, e-commerce and reporting rather than a classroom. It has made me practical: I look at a category, a customer or a distributor and ask what the data says and what would actually move the number.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, fluent in English, and used to working remotely with teams across markets. I learn best in a group, which is part of why the global trainee cohort appeals to me. I would be glad to talk through what I could bring to a rotation in Shopper Marketing or Distributor Excellence.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
